targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, '1h'), type || ' / ' || status AS metric, count(*)::numeric AS value FROM runs WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND ('$run_type' = 'All' OR type IN (${run_type:sqlstring})) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('failed', 'cancelled')) / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('completed', 'failed', 'cancelled')), 0) AS value FROM runs WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND ('$run_type' = 'All' OR type IN (${run_type:sqlstring}))

SELECT type AS metric, avg(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM completed_at - started_at)) AS value FROM runs WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND completed_at IS NOT NULL AND started_at IS NOT NULL AND ('$run_type' = 'All' OR type IN (${run_type:sqlstring})) GROUP BY type ORDER BY type

WITH event_iterations AS (SELECT task_id, max(COALESCE(iteration, 0)) AS latest_iteration FROM task_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY task_id), story_runs AS (SELECT story_id, count(*) AS run_count FROM runs WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND story_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY story_id) SELECT story_runs.story_id, story_runs.run_count, COALESCE(sum(event_iterations.latest_iteration), 0) AS task_iterations FROM story_runs LEFT JOIN tasks ON tasks.story_id = story_runs.story_id LEFT JOIN event_iterations ON event_iterations.task_id = tasks.id GROUP BY story_runs.story_id, story_runs.run_count HAVING story_runs.run_count > 1 OR COALESCE(sum(event_iterations.latest_iteration), 0) > 0 ORDER BY story_runs.run_count DESC, story_runs.story_id

SELECT COALESCE(agent_profile->>'name', agent_profile->>'agent_type', 'not recorded') AS metric, CASE WHEN count(total_tokens) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE sum(total_tokens) END AS value FROM runs WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND ('$run_type' = 'All' OR type IN (${run_type:sqlstring})) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT COALESCE(agent_profile->>'name', agent_profile->>'agent_type', 'not recorded') AS metric, CASE WHEN count(cost_usd) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE sum(cost_usd) END AS value FROM runs WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND ('$run_type' = 'All' OR type IN (${run_type:sqlstring})) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

list.name: run_type
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT type FROM runs ORDER BY 1
